title: Acyclic base case for normalized external cup
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X,Y$ quasi-compact $k$-schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals, and $F,G$ quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Use the scalar resolution models [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model] and normalization [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain]. Write $H^p$ for module right-derived global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. If $H^p(X,F)=H^p(Y,G)=0$ for all $p>0$, then for every normalized cochain realization $c$, $H^n(c)$ is an isomorphism for every $n\in\mathbb N$.

source.place: Varieties Tag 0BED proof after equation 33.29.1.1: exact coefficient sequences, two dimension-shifting inductions and acyclic Leray base case

proof.text: Choose finite affine covers and their product cover; affine diagonal makes all finite intersections affine. The affine pullback and tensor section formulas identify Cech on X times an affine V with Cech(X,F) tensor G(V). Exact field tensor and affine Cech comparison give zero positive cohomology and Gamma(X,F) tensor G(V) in degree zero.

Use the higher direct image presheaf description on the affine basis to identify pr2_* external coefficients with Gamma(X,F) tensor G and to prove higher direct images vanish. Expand Gamma(X,F) in a basis. Affine diagonal implies Y quasi-separated, so qcqs direct-sum cohomology and Leray show product cohomology is zero above zero and is the section tensor in degree zero.

The degree-zero section tensor identification sends s tensor t to projection pullbacks followed by tensor: check on every product affine chart using the section formulas. Signed Cech cup compatibility gives this formula for external cup. Natural-degree tensor Kunneth and the constructed model comparisons identify source homology with the section tensor in degree zero and with zero above zero. Lift factor homology classes through homology projections; the Kunneth cycle formula and the normalized cochain hypothesis identify H(c) on pure tensors. Extend by linearity. Thus H(c) is invertible in degree zero and between zero objects above zero.

theorem picardExternalCupCochain_isIso_of_acyclic
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hF : ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F))
    (hG : ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj G))
    (c : picardExternalTotal f g F G ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
    (hc : IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F G c) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c (n : ℤ))
